fitnesscoaches.label: Fitness clients
fitnesscoaches.title: Instagram DM Templates for Fitness Coaches
fitnesscoaches.h1: Instagram DM templates for fitness coaches
fitnesscoaches.intro: Six DM templates for online fitness coaches who find clients among people already sharing their training on Instagram. Each one uses spintax, so every person gets slightly different wording instead of a copied script.
tips: Comment on the training, not the body
Talk about their consistency, their lift or their routine. Remarks about how someone looks put people on guard fast.
Ask about the goal first
A question about what they are working towards tells you whether coaching fits before you mention it.
Target people mid-journey
People posting progress or gym hashtags are already committed. Followers of a big coach in your style already like that approach.
Keep the free offer small
A short form tip or a one-page plan is easy to say yes to. A full programme in the first DM feels like a trap.

personaltrainers.label: Local gym-goers
personaltrainers.title: Instagram DM Templates for Personal Trainers
personaltrainers.h1: Instagram DM templates for personal trainers
personaltrainers.intro: Six DM templates for in-person personal trainers who want to fill sessions with people nearby. Spintax varies the wording for each person, and you swap in your gym and area in the brackets.
tips: Lead with the location
People choose a trainer they can actually get to. Mention the area or gym early so the message feels local, not random.
Use local hashtags and gyms
Followers of your gym's account and people posting your city's fitness hashtags are the easiest list to start with.
Offer a taster, not a package
A free first session or a form check is a low-risk yes. Talk packages once you have met.
Watch your hourly cap
Local lists are small. Send slowly with breaks so you don't burn through your whole area in a day.

Mention what they sell or something from their recent posts. Owners ignore anything that could have been sent to anyone.
Ask where they are stuck
Questions about leads, pricing or time open conversations. A list of your credentials in the first DM rarely does.
Pick a stage
New founders and seven-figure owners need different things. Targeting one stage makes every message sharper.
Move to a call when they lean in
Once they describe a problem, offer a short call. Long DM threads stall.

lifecoaches.intro: Six gentle DM templates for life coaches who connect with people talking about change on Instagram. Spintax gives each person their own wording, and none of them open with a sales pitch.
tips: Be gentle
People share personal things publicly. Respond to what they said with care and never use their struggles as a hook.
Ask, then listen
One open question beats a paragraph about your method. Let them tell you what they want to change.
Target people already reflecting
Followers of coaches in your style and people posting growth or mindset hashtags are already thinking about change.
Respect a no
If someone says not now, thank them and stop. Opt-out detection helps, but your tone matters more.

Keep it human

A note from a real person at a small brand gets read. A message that sounds like an ad gets swiped away.
Target competitors' followers
People following similar brands already buy the category. Your job is to be worth a look.
Ask for feedback, not a sale
Asking what they look for in a product starts a conversation and teaches you something.
Make the offer simple
If you share a discount, make it one code and one link. No hoops.

Use drops as a reason

saas.intro: Six DM templates for SaaS founders reaching users and buyers on Instagram, from solo creators to small business owners. Spintax gives every message its own wording, and the openers start with a question about their workflow.
tips: Lead with the problem
Ask how they handle the task your product helps with. People talk about their problems more readily than they read about features.
Target your user, not founders in general
Followers of tools adjacent to yours and people in your users' niche hashtags are a better list than #startup.
Offer a trial or a walkthrough
A free trial or a short demo is the natural next step. Skip the feature list.
Ask for feedback even if they don't buy
A no with a reason is useful product research.

Candidates are wary of vague job DMs. Say what the role is and who it is for within the first message or two.
Target where the talent posts
Designers, chefs, stylists and creatives often show work on Instagram. Follow the hashtags they use.
Compliment the work
Mention a specific piece of their work. It shows you actually looked.
Make saying no easy
Plenty of people are happy where they are. A polite exit keeps the door open for later.

Brand inboxes are busy. A light nudge is normal; more is not.

mortgagebrokers.label: Home buyers
mortgagebrokers.title: Instagram DM Templates for Mortgage Brokers
mortgagebrokers.h1: Instagram DM templates for mortgage brokers
mortgagebrokers.intro: Six DM templates for mortgage brokers and loan officers reaching first-time buyers and movers on Instagram. Spintax varies every message, and none of them quote rates or promise approvals.
tips: Never quote rates in DMs
Rates and approvals depend on the person. Invite a proper conversation instead.
Follow your compliance rules
Lending is regulated. Keep messages factual and include any disclosures your rules require.
Target buyers in planning
People posting about saving for a home or house hunting are early in the process.
Partner with agents
Followers of local estate agents are often already looking.

insuranceagents.label: Local clients
insuranceagents.title: Instagram DM Templates for Insurance Agents
insuranceagents.h1: Instagram DM templates for insurance agents
insuranceagents.intro: Six DM templates for insurance agents reaching people at moments when cover matters, like a new home, a new baby or a new business. Spintax varies every message, and the tone stays helpful rather than salesy.
tips: Meet the moment
New homes, new babies, new businesses and new cars all raise insurance questions. Message around those moments.
Lead with congratulations
Celebrate the news first. Cover can come up in the second message.
Follow your compliance rules
Insurance marketing is regulated. Keep messages factual and avoid promises about premiums.
Offer a review, not a policy
A free review of what they have now is low pressure and useful.

interiordesigners.title: Instagram DM Templates for Interior Designers
interiordesigners.h1: Instagram DM templates for interior designers
interiordesigners.intro: Six DM templates for interior designers reaching homeowners who are renovating, moving or saving room ideas. Spintax varies each message, and the openers ask about their space before offering design help.
tips: Ask about the room
A question about the space they are working on opens a real conversation.
Show matching work
Send a project in a similar style or budget. It is easier to picture.
Target renovators
People posting renovation and new home hashtags are making decisions right now.
Offer a small first step
A consultation or a mood board is a lighter yes than a full project.

eventplanners.label: Hosts
eventplanners.title: Instagram DM Templates for Event Planners
eventplanners.h1: Instagram DM templates for event planners
eventplanners.intro: Six DM templates for event planners reaching people planning birthdays, launches, corporate events and celebrations. Spintax varies the wording for every message, and each opener asks about their event first.
tips: Ask about the event
Date, size and vibe tell you whether you are the right planner. Start there.
Target by occasion
Hashtags for milestone birthdays, baby showers and launches show who is planning now.
Share a similar event
Photos from an event of the same type help people picture what you would do.
Be clear about what you handle
Full planning, on-the-day coordination or styling. Say which so people know what they are getting.

artistssellingart.label: Collectors
artistssellingart.title: Instagram DM Templates for Artists Selling Art
artistssellingart.h1: Instagram DM templates for artists selling art
artistssellingart.intro: Six DM templates for painters, illustrators and makers reaching people who collect or admire work like theirs. Spintax keeps every message worded differently, and the openers share the work before any mention of price.
tips: Reach people who already love the style
Followers of artists in your style and galleries you would show at are your natural collectors.
Share, don't sell
Send a piece you think they would like and ask what they think. Interest leads to sales.
Mention commissions plainly
If you take commissions, say so once and explain how they work when asked.
Use new work as a reason
A new series or a fresh drop is the most natural time to message.
